reply_text:
I'm running 小象's reader on two days of logs first, to time it before the full window.㊥ Gist: You're right, 小象's reader (`xiaoxiang_reader.py`) already takes a `--gap-hours` option. It's now running over the last 41 days with the threshold set to 3, and its output also includes the 6-, 1- and 0-hour views. It reads all 13 GB of Claude and Codex logs, and a two-day trial was still going after five minutes, so the full run will take a while. I can't park on a background process, so the run won't wake me when it finishes. Ask me when you want the result, or check `scripts/bg.py status bg-1790891605209-17`.

㊟ (what its gaps measure: three differences from the Minard panel)
- **Source of your turns:** it finds your typed turns in the agents' own transcripts, not in futon1b. A relayed turn counts as yours only if its header says `Origin: operator`.
- **Early wake-ups split gaps:** before 27 September, park wake-ups were delivered with `From: joe / Origin: operator` headers. That's the 330 I filtered out of the backfill. The reader will count those as typed turns, so some overnight gaps before the 27th will be split or will vanish. That biases toward finding fewer and shorter gaps in that period, not more.
- **Which agents' tokens:** they come from Claude and Codex logs, including cached input. Kimi and Zai work, such as today's overnight loops, runs through Agency rather than those logs and won't appear.

㊢ (where it writes) `/tmp/claude17/xr/gaps-3h.json` and `gaps-3h.html`. When it finishes I'll publish the page next to the Minard one, and report the 3- and 6-hour gaps from 21 September onward with their token counts.

㊥ Gist: This wake-up came early. My deadline-only park was released immediately because it had nothing to wait on, so the gap run isn't finished. It's still running (`bg-1790891605209-17`, alive) and has no output yet. Ask me when you want the result, or check `~/code/futon3c/scripts/bg.py status bg-1790891605209-17`. It has finished once `/tmp/claude17/xr/gaps-3h.json` stops being empty.

㊩ (the park) A park with an empty `awaiting` list is answered with "released-immediately", and the wake payload is delivered straight away, which is what you're seeing now. So a deadline alone can't be used to check back on a background process. I won't re-park, since another empty park would only release again.
